change: only replace zero range_bias_m by per-link P1 median offsets

original_config.source_method: existing single-car fixed-height SE(2) batch graph with minimal rotating lever-arm adaptation
original_config.reference_assumption: approximate surveyed chassis geometric center assumed equal to odom base_footprint; unmeasured
original_config.start_status: candidate inherited from other L runs, not independently measured for these bags
original_config.clock: sensor headers and cmd reception use recorded ROS wall-clock seconds minus first bag receipt; no fitted clock correction
original_config.keyframes: arange(ceil(max(first odom header, first UWB header)+1), floor(min(last odom header,last UWB header)),1)
original_config.range_robust_loss: existing pseudo-Huber on normalized ranges only, delta=1; odom/prior Gaussian; scipy loss=linear

optimizer.failure_policy: retain finite iterate for diagnosis; exclude failed solve from accepted accuracy claim

evaluation.statistic: median estimated antenna X and Y at frozen keyframes

filter.neighbor_policy: centered header-time window, original baseline-valid values, exclude self; no iterative filtering
filter.threshold_basis: exploratory 0.20 m/s antenna speed envelope * 0.5 s + 0.25 m margin = 0.35 m; MAD handles local variation; not validated
filter.insufficient_support: keep if physically feasible; flag insufficient support
filter.known_limit: cannot certify correct values or remove stable bias or majority corruption

original_config.parameter_policy: inherited Oct17 weights are unvalidated pilot settings; no tuning to endpoints or historical results
original_config.imu: diagnostic only; odom yaw may share IMU source
